title: On Horseback
author: Charles Dudley Warner
description: "On Horseback" by Charles Dudley Warner is a travel narrative likely written during the late 19th century.
longDescription: The book chronicles the adventures of a Professor and his companion, the Friend of Humanity, as they embark on an exploration of the countryside in Virginia and parts of North Carolina, primarily focusing on life, landscape, and the characters they meet along their journey.
